others.route: Leidimas laikinai gyventi (temporary residence permit as a performer)

note: Lithuania: EEA and Swiss nationals live and work freely (the eea list). A performer from anywhere else must obtain a temporary residence permit or, if eligible, a national long-term visa, on a mediation letter from the inviting public legal entity filed in the Migration Department's MIGRIS and a document confirming the artist's activity (the European Commission's EU Immigration Portal, its Lithuania pages, updated 1 April 2025). The Law on the Legal Status of Aliens itself (article 58's exemptions from the work permit) wasn't read: e-tar.lt, e-seimas.lrs.lt, migracija.lrv.lt and uzt.lt put up a bot challenge. No days of work without the permit are named, so none are modelled.

sources.title: European Commission, EU Immigration Portal: Self-employed worker in Lithuania (1 April 2025)
sources.said: If you are a sportsman, a trainer, a performer, an accredited journalist or you come to carry out governmental programmes, or you are a member of a recognised religious community, you must obtain a temporary residence permit or, if you qualify, a national long-term visa. ... the number of a mediation letter that was electronically filled in and submitted by your entity (in case you are a sportsman, a trainer, a performer or you come to carry out governmental programmes, or you are a member of a recognised religious community);
